ctx.x: This guy was the band. This was the cushion. What give it that sound. I still thought there was a possibility, after Mercer had kept -- you know, after Carney was still there, I said, well, it's a chance, you know, with Carney, with that bottom still there, and maybe he can build something from there, you know. So -- but now all of them's gone. All of them's gone. So I think -- I think he would have made the biggest change in the band there ever was, if Carney had come out before the rest of them, had he left…
Yeah. Well, especially the way he wrote for the --
